culprit_citations.quoted_text: ABC Technologies Inc. (TI Automotive) (Canada) | First Lien Term Loan | EURIBOR(M) | Principal EUR 17,232,443.00

findings.detail: The source principal is EUR 17,232,443.00, but principal_amount_usd is missing, so explicit FX normalization was not populated.

rationale: Class 1 repeated single-cell defect. Raw source table 12 row 24 explicitly marks the debt principal with a euro currency symbol and reports 17,232,443.00, while FX01 identifies the corresponding USD-normalized principal field as blank. The non-USD source amount therefore requires an explicit FX conversion that the extracted row lacks. No independent conversion-rate anchor is disclosed in the cited row, so this verdict establishes the missing normalization but does not assert a reconstructed USD amount.
